integrity: Analytical proof covers all finite dimensions; standalone exact-integer and numerical checks are corroboration only. One self-consistent claim and proof, with no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite cyclic sites, unweighted adjacent variation and counting vertex l1; full-support required only for complete equality classification; heat is unnormalized combinatorial cycle heat. Sparse-support equality families, weighted cycles and higher-dimensional tori are not classified. Historically equivalent results outside inspected material remain possible.
title: Sharp cyclic BV approximation by Markov convolutions and a Bernstein heat-error law
